Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Distressed Persian Area Rug, 5 x 8 Foot, Blue Multicolor
Materials: Nylon
Enliven your home decor with this lovely Persian-inspired rug. Blue, pale yellow, and white hues create a traditional Persian design that will add interest to any room. A distressed look adds to this rug’s authentic-vintage feel. 5' x 8' Pile: 100% nylon The soft, compact pile of this luxurious rug makes it both beautiful and practical. A handstitched binding gives it a handcrafted, elevated look. The low 0.25" pile makes this rug perfect for medium- to high-traffic areas like bedrooms or living rooms. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
